name: B10-0107/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean DBN-09004-6 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of a genetically modified soybean, called DBN-09004-6, for food and animal feed. The soybean is engineered to survive spraying with two weedkillers, glyphosate and glufosinate. Parliament says the safety checks were not thorough enough, that glufosinate is banned in the European Union, and that relying on these weedkillers harms soil, water, wildlife and health. Parliament also says Member States never backed the plan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only objects and asks the Commission to drop the plan.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed businesses, consumers, and anyone worried about pesticide use.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan.
